ai.title: Circe: Training-Free LLM Self-Evaluation via Component Interaction Consistency
ai.raw_summary: arXiv:2611.07948v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in real-world applications, evaluating the correctness of their responses is crucial for reliable use. However, such evaluation is challenging because reference answers are rarely available in practice. Existing reference-free methods mainly rely on output signals, which may assign high scores to incorrect responses and thus do not necessarily reflect correctness. This motivates exploring the model's internal computation for complementary correctness signals. Recent studies exploit internal states, but they mainly analyze hidden-state trajectories across layers, which record only the combined updates of attention and feed-forward networks (FFNs) and overlook how these components interact. We therefore propose Circe, a training-free self-evaluation method that assesses a response using both internal and external signals, without reference answers or repeated sampling. For internal signals, we first introduce component interaction consistency (CIC), which measures the directional alignment between attention updates in earlier layers and attention-induced FFN output changes in later layers. We further incorporate representation geometry (RG) to characterize normalized displacement and angular changes along layerwise hidden-state trajectories. ai.title: DictLLM: Post-training Compression of Large Language Model with Dictionary Kernels
ai.raw_summary: arXiv:2611.08082v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Efficient deployment of large language models (LLMs) on mobile devices requires balancing performance with compute and memory constraints. Post-training compression is an effective approach to managing this trade-off, while requiring much less computation than in-training counterparts. We propose DictLLM, a dictionary-based compression scheme in which weight matrices within grouped layers are decomposed into a shared dictionary and layer-specific sparse coefficients, directly obtained from a pre-trained model without further training. Specifically, we cast DictLLM as a four-step post-training optimization. First, we obtain shared dictionaries via singular value decomposition (SVD) of input-scaled weight matrices, amortizing rank across grouped layers; second, we sparsify the layer-specific coefficients to the target compression ratio using a dictionary-aware Hessian; and third, we refine the dictionaries given the resulting sparse coefficients. Finally, we aggressively quantize both components using factor-specific Hessian information: input covariance for the dictionaries and the dictionary-aware Hessian for the coefficients. The resulting representation reduces memory footprint by storing a single shared dictionary per layer group, along with sparse layer-specific coefficients. ai.summary: Efficient deployment of large language models (LLMs) on mobile devices requires balancing performance with compute and memory constraints.

ai.title: The Power of Meta Access in the Software of the Future --- Demonstrated on LLM Chat UIs and Chat AI
ai.raw_summary: arXiv:2611.08428v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Chat remains the default surface for many large language model (LLM) tasks, even as agentic tools such as OpenCode excel at coding and automation. Yet the model sees the current dialogue but not the workspace around it. We explore meta access---giving the assistant a structured, permissioned view of the interface itself and propose a ladder of levels: feature tutoring; metadata, settings, and preference access; retrieval over summaries and messages, confirmed mutation, and full orchestration. Meta access can turn a chat client from many screens into one entry point for finding, navigating, organising, and operating it, while raising risks around grounding, privacy, prompt injection, and trust. General-purpose agentic harnesses are runtimes; because they can change their own settings, meta access becomes reflexive and needs a separate control-plane boundary. We ground this in the Meta Chat prototype of the Chat AI client. It builds bounded context from, e.g., summaries, settings, and relevant messages; links references to conversations, topics, and personas; supports confirmed, reversible changes; offers a browsable tutorial library; and recommends personas as user-started conversations. By exposing application state in structured form, meta access can extend screen readers from widget descriptions to semantic workspace operations. ai.title: Accelerating Long-Context Decoding in Large-Scale Hybrid LLMs Without Retraining
ai.raw_summary: arXiv:2611.06133v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The full-attention layers of large language models (LLMs) make every generated token more expensive than the previous one, slowing models down on long-context tasks. Hybrid models reduce this cost by replacing most full-attention layers with linear-attention layers, but the first still dominate decoding at long contexts. We accelerate these remaining layers without any training or weight changes using combined sparse attention: each layer attends to a sliding window of recent tokens, a pinned prefix, and a fixed budget of most relevant tokens in the context. The window size and budget are found on a per-layer basis using a multi-objective search algorithm. Across six hybrid models from three families, from 4B to 397B parameters, the selected configurations preserve their baseline model's accuracy on 21 long-context datasets. Decoding 64k/256k tokens becomes up to 1.26x/2.22x faster on Qwen3.5-4B, 1.20x/2.23x on Qwen3.5-122B-A10B, and 1.16x/2.06x on Ornith-1.0-397B.

ai.title: PAYWORTHY: Can LLMs Predict Which Freelance Jobs an AI Agent Will Complete?
ai.raw_summary: arXiv:2611.05759v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Before an AI agent takes on a paid job, someone has to judge whether it is likely to succeed. We test whether frontier language models can make this call before any attempt. We propose PAYWORTHY which contains 1{,}494 real freelance job postings, sampled from 18.8M postings made between 2020 and 2026 on a freelancing platform. An agent attempts each job from the posting alone in a single run, and an LLM judge acting as the client decides whether to accept the work. We ask 18 models to forecast how likely the agent is to succeed and measure how well each model's forecasts rank the accepted jobs above the rejected ones (AUC, where 0.5 is a random ranking). The answer depends on how the agent is described. Told what the agent cannot do, every model ranks the jobs well (AUC 0.66--0.86). Told instead that it is a generic agent with a browser and code execution, the same models rank the same jobs about as well as a random ordering (0.45--0.56). These results hold under judges from four other model families (Claude, GLM, Kimi and Qwen), and the informed forecasts also rank the verdicts of two human raters. Code is available at https://github.com/upwork/Payworthy
ai.summary: Before an AI agent takes on a paid job, someone has to judge whether it is likely to succeed.

ai.title: Democracy Assistance: State Department Should Improve Congressional Notification of Its Use of Certain Legal Authorities
ai.raw_summary: What GAO Found Federal law contains certain provisions, known as notwithstanding authorities, that allow agencies to provide funding that would otherwise be restricted. Historically, the annual appropriations act has required agencies to notify Congress if they intend to use a notwithstanding authority to provide assistance in countries where U.S. law prohibits U.S. funding. In fiscal years (FY) 2023 and 2024, the joint explanatory statement (JES) accompanying the act included additional directions for providing such notifications. In July 2025 the Secretary of State announced that USAID had ceased to implement foreign assistance. State assumed certain former USAID functions, including some democracy programs, and will submit congressional notifications related to future democracy assistance. While Congress has not included a JES with directions for providing information on notwithstanding authorities with every appropriations act, it did so in fiscal year 2026 and may continue to do so in the future. GAO’s review of 37 State congressional notifications for FYs 2023 and 2024 funding found that 36 of the notifications do not address one of three criteria, specified in Section 7015(c) of the FYs 2023 and 2024 appropriations acts or in their JESs, for reporting the use of notwithstanding authorities. From April 2025 to April 2026, following a January 2025 Executive Order, U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) added over 40 detention facilities that detain noncitizens for over 72 hours. The average daily population of detained noncitizens grew by over 50 percent, to 61,817 individuals, over the timeframe. From fiscal year 2024 to July 2026, three of the four DHS entities that conducted inspections changed the frequency (decreased or increased) or stopped conducting inspections. ICE has not used evidence, such as data on deficiencies identified through inspections and performance information such as the extent to which facilities are in compliance with their contracts, to determine the effects of these recent changes on facility conditions. ai.raw_summary: Commission preliminarily finds TikTok’s ‘For You’ feed in breach of Digital Services Act for harmful ‘rabbit holes’ effect Anonymous (not verified) Fri, 11/06/2026 - 12:09 The European Commission has preliminarily found TikTok in breach of the Digital Services Act (DSA) for the so-called ‘rabbit hole effect’ of its recommender system. TikTok's ‘For You' feed shows users a continuous stream of personalised videos, even when those are related to mental health struggles and body image. The more a user interacts with a certain type of content, the more TikTok's ‘For You' feed algorithm recommends similar content. This design can be harmful when such endless and repeated exposure involves, for example, content about sadness, isolation or body image. These ‘rabbit holes' can have a detrimental impact on users' mental health, especially that of vulnerable adults and minors. These preliminary findings focus on both risk assessment and mitigation measures. ai.title: U.S. Patent and Trademark Office: Patent Backlog Reduction Efforts Pose Risks to Examiner Retention and Examination Quality
ai.raw_summary: What GAO Found The backlog of unexamined patent applications awaiting an initial decision from the United States Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO) rose to about 838,000 applications in January 2025. In September 2025, the USPTO announced a goal to reduce the backlog to under 599,000 applications but did not specify a time frame for reaching it. The backlog was last at that level in 2020. To reduce the backlog, the USPTO is requiring patent examiners to review more applications, has decreased examiner training, and has expanded the use of AI patent search tools. As of August 2026, the USPTO reduced the backlog to about 756,000 applications, but average applicant wait times for a final patentability decision had increased by 11 percent since January 2025. GAO’s analysis found that, even with examiners doing more work, the USPTO is unlikely to reduce the backlog to under 599,000 patent applications before 2031 without lowering examiner attrition (see figure). The examiner attrition rate increased from 2.9 percent in fiscal year 2020 to 7.6 percent in fiscal year 2025. The agency is seeking to hire more examiners, but if high examiner attrition continues, it will affect the USPTO’s ability to reduce the backlog. As of August 2026, the 12-month examiner attrition rate was 7.6 percent. trade.raw_summary: 「美國汽車售後服務零配件展(AAPEX )」於本(11)月3日至5日在美國拉斯維加斯盛大登場，為協助業者深耕北美市場，經濟部攜手車輛公會、手工具公會及汽配業者籌組「旗艦臺灣館」，邀集219家企業參展，為本屆第3大參展國，以「Team Taiwan」為主軸，向國際買主展現臺灣汽配產業的創新實力與供應鏈優勢，提升臺灣汽配產業在全球汽車售後市場的能見度與信賴度，促成商機逾6,000萬美元。 經濟部表示，AAPEX已與「美國汽車改裝零配件展（SEMA）」結合成為「汽車售後服務週」，為全球汽車零組件產業重要採購平臺，亦是臺灣業者拓展北美市場的重要據點。今年首度籌組SEMA參展團並結合台灣精品館，展示輔助駕駛、車聯網及車隊管理等領域的科技成果及智慧移動與車用電子研發實力，透過同時進軍AAPEX與SEMA雙展，協助業者掌握售後服務與改裝件市場雙重商機。 美國為臺灣汽車零配件最大出口市場，占我國汽配出口比重約50%。隨著全球車輛朝向電動化、智慧化發展及售後服務市場需求持續成長，本次我國參展業者集結了全球最大碰撞件製造商、汽車售後市場車燈領導品牌、車用電子產品大廠及摩擦材料製造等指標性廠商，彰顯臺灣汽車零配件之製造技術與智慧科技的創新能量，3天展期共吸引1,050位買主及訪客參與洽談及交流。 本次旗艦臺灣館也特別設置產業應用情境展示區，展出內容涵蓋傳統汽車零組件、車用電子及智慧移動解決方案，完整呈現臺灣汽配產業從精密製造、技術研發到智慧應用的產業生態系。另規劃數位行銷專區（Digital Zone）及商務洽談區，透過產品發表、亮點展示及產業趨勢分享會等活動，打造兼具展示推廣、交流互動及商機媒合功能的國際行銷平臺；亦與金屬工業研究發展中心合作，邀請專家提供關稅與供應鏈布局建議及諮詢。此外，舉辦「臺灣之夜」交流活動，匯聚230位美國重要買主與臺灣業者，深化商務連結並拓展合作契機。 經濟部指出，因應全球經貿情勢變化，政府運用韌性特別預算，透過籌組海外拓銷團、參與指標性國際展覽、邀請買主來臺及洽談採購等多元方式，協助臺灣企業拓展海外市場。繼美國汽配展後，經濟部將陸續組團參加慕尼黑電子展(Electronica)、杜賽道夫醫療展(MEDICA)及日本國際橡塑膠展(IPF)等國際大型展覽，並打造旗艦臺灣館，全方位協助多元產業海外拓銷。 貿易署發言人：經濟部國際貿易署 胡副署長 聯絡電話：02-2397-7109、02-2397-7178、0966-525-106 業務聯絡人：貿易發展組黃科長 聯絡電話：02-2397-7306

trade.title: 「雙11」跨境網購請小心，貨品輸入規定要認清！
trade.source_name: 財政部關務署 新聞
trade.via: 財政部關務署 新聞
trade.raw_summary: 「雙11」購物季是跨境網購的大旺季，財政部關務署提醒民眾切勿錯認「網站買得到就能合法進口」！倘若商品屬於輸入管制貨品，必須取得貨品主管機關許可文件才能進口，海關呼籲民眾跨境網購前務必先確認貨品是否涉及輸入規定，否則可能因違規而受罰。 財政部關務署表示，跨境網購商品種類繁多，常見如應施檢疫之動植物產品（如肉乾、種子）、醫療器材及藥品（如輪椅、玻尿酸）、電信管制射頻器材（如無線耳機）、應施檢驗商品（如玩具、行動電源）及管制輸入大陸物品（如螺螄粉、花生）等，進口時均應分別遵守農業部動植物防疫檢疫署、衛生福利部食品藥物管理署、國家通訊傳播委員會、經濟部標準檢驗局及經濟部國際貿易署等貨品主管機關的輸入規定辦理。因相關規定分散於不同主管機關，民眾往往不清楚哪些商品需要事先申請許可，一不小心就可能觸法。 該署說明，為提醒跨境網購民眾留意貨品輸入規定，已依立法院林委員岱樺質詢建議，彙整各貨品主管機關提供常見涉及輸入規定貨品資料，請關貿網路股份有限公司於「EZ Way 易利委」APP首頁及預先委任畫面，今年11月3日前建置「網購貨物常見涉輸入規定查詢參考」功能。民眾只需輸入貨品關鍵字，就能查詢相關輸入規定、主管機關聯絡資訊及注意事項；為使民眾更容易理解，再以顏色區分，其中，紅色代表禁止輸入或須事先取得輸入許可、黃色則代表限量內可免申請輸入許可，超過限量就須事先申請，讓民眾一目了然。 關務署進一步表示，為滿足民眾查詢其他商品的需求，透過EZ Way APP「AI貨品稅則查詢」連結至該署「貨品歸屬稅則查詢系統」，方便查詢貨品稅則稅率、輸入規定及主管機關等詳細資訊。除了透過EZ Way APP查詢，民眾亦可利用關港貿單一窗口「(GC473)貨品輸出入查詢」網頁查詢貨品輸出入規定，該網頁以貨品類型分類（如食品、藥品、農產品等），提供民眾更全面查詢貨品輸出入相關規定的服務。 關務署最後提醒，「網購先查清，收貨更安心！」跨境網購除了比價格、看評價，更要確認商品能不能合法進口。尤其同一貨物可能涉及多個貨品主管機關輸入規定，必須全數符合始得進口，民眾如有疑問可先洽詢貨品主管機關，避免因不諳法規而導致貨物延遲通關，甚至面臨貨物退運或遭裁罰等情形。該署呼籲切勿聽信境外劣質業者不實廣告，唯有事前查明規定、誠實申報，方可享受便捷安全之通關服務。 新聞稿聯絡人：陳科長 聯絡電話：（02）25505500分機2521

trade.title: U.S. Patent and Trademark Office: Patent Backlog Reduction Efforts Pose Risks to Examiner Retention and Examination Quality
trade.raw_summary: What GAO Found The backlog of unexamined patent applications awaiting an initial decision from the United States Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO) rose to about 838,000 applications in January 2025. In September 2025, the USPTO announced a goal to reduce the backlog to under 599,000 applications but did not specify a time frame for reaching it. The backlog was last at that level in 2020. To reduce the backlog, the USPTO is requiring patent examiners to review more applications, has decreased examiner training, and has expanded the use of AI patent search tools. As of August 2026, the USPTO reduced the backlog to about 756,000 applications, but average applicant wait times for a final patentability decision had increased by 11 percent since January 2025. GAO’s analysis found that, even with examiners doing more work, the USPTO is unlikely to reduce the backlog to under 599,000 patent applications before 2031 without lowering examiner attrition (see figure). The examiner attrition rate increased from 2.9 percent in fiscal year 2020 to 7.6 percent in fiscal year 2025. The agency is seeking to hire more examiners, but if high examiner attrition continues, it will affect the USPTO’s ability to reduce the backlog. As of August 2026, the 12-month examiner attrition rate was 7.6 percent. world.raw_summary: 俄罗斯借助由老旧油轮组成的"影子舰队"规避西方制裁。据报道，特朗普政府正考虑解除部分影子舰队油轮的制裁，以缓解创纪录的运费。专家警告，此举将削弱对俄制裁、帮助莫斯科获得收入，并使美欧在战略上分道扬镳。欧盟虽握有航运和保险等工具，但若没有美国支持，执法将更加艰难。
